warning.titlePre: Mercedes Viano 3.0 CDI Swirl Flap & Injector Wear
paragraphs: If your Viano 3.0 CDI has the OM642 diesel V6 — that’s the W639 generation, produced from 2003 to 2014 — swirl flap and injector wear is a well‑documented pattern on this engine, backed by multiple manufacturer technical service bulletins. We replace worn swirl flaps, injector seals and the timing chain as standard on every OM642 rebuild.
